entries.template: In how many different ways can {totalObjects} people sit around a round table if rotations of the same seating are treated as identical?
At a round-table meeting of {totalObjects} people, one person is fixed as the reference. In how many relative seatings can the remaining people be arranged?
Among {totalObjects} people seated around a round table, two specified people must sit together. How many arrangements are possible?
Among {totalObjects} people seated around a round table, two specified people must not sit together. How many arrangements are possible?
Among {totalObjects} people seated around a round table, {blockSize} specified people must occupy consecutive seats. How many arrangements are possible?
Among {totalObjects} people seated around a round table, two disjoint specified pairs must each sit together. How many arrangements are possible?
Among {totalObjects} people seated around a round table, one specified pair and a separate specified group of {secondBlockSize} people must each sit together. How many arrangements are possible?
Among {totalObjects} people seated around a round table, one specified pair must sit together while another disjoint specified pair must not sit together. How many arrangements are possible?
Among {totalObjects} people seated around a round table, two specified pairs must each sit together, but the two formed pair-blocks must not be adjacent. How many arrangements are possible?
Among {totalObjects} people seated around a round table, at least one of two disjoint specified pairs must sit together. How many arrangements are possible?
Among {totalObjects} people seated around a round table, neither of two disjoint specified pairs may sit together. How many arrangements are possible?
Among {totalObjects} people seated around a round table, A must sit between B and C and be adjacent to both. How many arrangements are possible?
An even number of {totalObjects} people sit around a round table. In how many arrangements do A and B occupy opposite seats?
Among {totalObjects} people seated around a round table, A must sit immediately clockwise of B. How many arrangements are possible?
Among {totalObjects} people seated around a round table, exactly {gapCount} people must lie between A and B when moving clockwise from A to B. How many arrangements are possible?
Among {totalObjects} people seated around a round table, at least {minimumGap} people must lie between A and B when moving clockwise from A to B. How many arrangements are possible?
Among {totalObjects} people seated around a round table, at most {maximumGap} people may lie between A and B when moving clockwise from A to B. How many arrangements are possible?
Among {totalObjects} people seated around a round table, A, B and C must occur in that clockwise order, not necessarily consecutively. How many arrangements are possible?
Among {totalObjects} people seated around a round table, A, B, C and D must occur in that clockwise order, not necessarily consecutively. How many arrangements are possible?
There are {categorySize} members of Category A and {categorySize} members of Category B. In how many round-table arrangements do the two categories alternate?
There are {largeCount} members of Category A and {smallCount} members of Category B. In how many round-table arrangements are no two Category B members adjacent?
Among {totalObjects} people seated around a round table, {specifiedCount} are specially identified. In how many arrangements are no two identified people adjacent?
The number of distinct round-table seatings of n people is {target}, where rotations are identical. Find n.
The number of round-table arrangements of n people in which a specified pair sits together is {target}. Find n.
In how many ways can {totalObjects} distinct symbols be placed on a one-sided circular display if rotations are identical but mirror images are different?
In how many necklaces can {totalObjects} distinct beads be arranged if rotations and mirror images are both treated as identical?
In how many necklaces can {totalObjects} distinct beads be arranged if two specified beads must be adjacent and rotations and mirror images are both treated as identical?
